notes.title: Current Product Range in the SuperStore Simulator
notes.notes:
Hello, SuperStore Simulator fans!
First of all, we want to express our deepest gratitude for your continued support and for following the development progress of our game. Your feedback and enthusiasm inspire us to keep pushing the boundaries of what we can achieve in SuperStore Simulator!

What is a Planogram?
In today’s devlog, we’d like to introduce you to a key concept in store management: the planogram. A planogram is a visual representation or a detailed layout of how and where products should be placed on store shelves. Retailers use it to optimize space, improve the customer shopping experience, and ensure that the most important products are easily accessible. Planograms help guide employees in restocking shelves, ensuring consistency in the product placement across the entire store.
The purpose of a planogram is simple: increase sales by positioning products in a way that catches the customer’s eye and encourages purchases. This system also helps stores maintain a clean and organized look, making it easier for customers to find what they need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/11915f1ac9d15bfd0de7dd8e89a196e792110744.gif[/img]


Current Product Range in the Store
As of now, the store in SuperStore Simulator is fully stocked with essential commodities, including fresh bread, fruits and vegetables, and other grocery staples. These are the everyday products that your customers will rely on, and organizing them effectively using planograms will be crucial for keeping your store running smoothly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/f66bbff7103acd7bdf2117ea060148a5d2bb9c5c.gif[/img]

Stay Tuned!
Once again, thank you for your incredible support and dedication to following our development journey. We have many more exciting features on the way, and we encourage you to keep up with our devlogs here on Steam for more updates and insights into the development of SuperStore Simulator. 
Don’t forget to follow the progress of Family Land - Farmer Simulator, which will be one of the suppliers of agricultural products to our Superstore.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2334600/Family_Land__Farmer_Simulator/
Until next time, happy simulating!

notes.title: Superstore Simulator Devlog #6 The Importance of Store Traffic
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/1713d04846b13e1e7e4f9ecfd1cc3130959c7b48.png[/img][h1]

[b]Hello, Superstore Managers! [/b][/h1]

In today’s devlog, we’ll be focusing on one of the most important aspects of running a successful store: traffic. Store traffic refers to the number of customers entering your shop, and it plays a vital role in your store’s potential profits. The more people visit, the higher your chances of making sales.

[h1][b]Location Matters[/b][/h1]

One of the key factors in driving traffic is your store’s location. In Superstore Simulator, placing your store near densely populated residential areas, such as apartment blocks, can significantly increase customer flow. These areas provide a steady stream of potential buyers right at your doorstep, ensuring a consistent traffic flow that boosts your daily sales. By strategically positioning your store in a high-traffic area, you can maximize your chances of attracting more customers, ultimately leading to higher profits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/193d4c0055f8c79145725ede2d871e7e0e4fa96f.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Why Traffic is Crucial for Profitability[/b][/h1]

Without a healthy amount of foot traffic, even the best-stocked shelves won't lead to success. High traffic means more opportunities to convert visitors into paying customers. It’s not just about getting people through the door; it's about creating an environment where frequent visits turn into consistent sales, helping your business thrive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/4ec03c760f8290154e89700d3f92442b9d297499.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Thank You for Your Support![/b][/h2]

We’re grateful for your continued interest and feedback as we develop Superstore Simulator! Don’t forget to check out Universum Gas Station, where you’ll find exciting game deals and exclusive offers. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue improving your virtual superstore experience.

notes.title: Superstore Simulator Devlog #5: Crafting the Perfect Store Environment
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Superstore Managers![/h2]

Welcome to our fourth devlog for Superstore Simulator! As we continue developing the game, we're thrilled to share some exciting updates about the work we've been doing on the store's surroundings. Your superstore isn't just about the aisles and shelves inside; it's also about the vibrant environment outside that brings your business to life.

[b]Delivery Zone Dynamics[/b]

First up, the delivery zone. Picture a bustling area where delivery trucks are constantly arriving with fresh products from your suppliers. Your task will be to manage this never-ending stream of deliveries efficiently, ensuring that your shelves are always stocked and your customers are always satisfied. The delivery zone will be a hive of activity, with vehicles queuing up to unload their goods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/1bfa8699f936ffcbaad4b2313272e575964a6fbe.gif[/img]

[b]Residential Surroundings[/b]

Next, let's talk about the residential surroundings. Your superstore will be nestled among buildings filled with potential customers. These residential areas are crucial for your store's success, as they represent the primary source of foot traffic and customer flow. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/3e97c9b5be8d1e6e93e6e5a2976c574940584551.jpg[/img]

[b]Expansive Parking Lot[/b]

Finally, we have the expansive parking lot. A well-managed parking lot is key to accommodating the influx of customers, especially during peak shopping hours. With effective advertising, you can ensure this parking lot fills up with the cars of eager shoppers, all ready to explore what your superstore has to offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/fcf34bc0598c015c646ac302ac6b23fa6ca530a6.png[/img]

We’re continuously working on making the Superstore Simulator environment as dynamic and immersive as possible. Your feedback and enthusiasm keep us motivated to create the ultimate superstore experience!

Before we sign off, we have some exciting news! Our talented colleagues have just released a teaser for Car Dealer Simulator. Check it out on the game's Steam page and get a sneak peek at what’s coming next!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

Thank you for being part of our journey, and stay tuned for more updates!

The Superstore Simulator Team

notes.title: SuperStore Devlog #4: Make Your Customers Happy 😊
notes.notes:
Depending on who you ask, there are many ingredients to run a successful SuperStore. Some will say it's the selection of the right products 🛍️, others will claim it's all about location, location, location 📍. Maybe it’s the placement of the shelves and the products on them 🗂️? In our opinion, the main ingredient is one: the happiness of your customers 😊. In today's devlog, we will talk about just that. So, how will you make your customers happy in SuperStore?

[b]Have a Variety of Products[/b] 🛒
Each customer will come to the store with their shopping list 📋. Whether they find what they need or not is crucial to their happiness 😃. So, it’s always a good idea to have a variety of products so everyone can find what they need.

[b]Make the Prices Fair [/b]💲
As you set up prices and promotions for each product, it’s very important not to be too greedy 😈. Of course, you run a business and need to make a profit 💼, but if the prices are too high, even if someone finds what they’re looking for, they might not buy it and won't be happy about it 😞.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/a35e2595022feb2f4090b3c035f3215e8535713e.png[/img]

[b]Don’t Make Them Wait[/b] ⏳
No one likes to wait in lines 🚶 - and neither do your customers. So, don’t make them wait. Whether it’s at the register 🛒, the toilet 🚻, or even to enter the shop 🚪, swift actions ensure that the store runs smoothly and everyone leaves happy 😊. If they wait too long ⏱️, they might leave the shop and abandon their goods - which means more for you to clean up 🧹.

[b]Clean Up Your Mess[/b] 🧽
Running a store can create a lot of mess 🗑️ - empty boxes 📦, clogged toilets 🚽, products and baskets left on the floor 🧺, or even items destroyed during shopping 🛍️. Every messy item decreases customer happiness 😣. So, grab your broom and get to work 🧹.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/1eebe6befa2728489305adbf85de9d4a1ef171b2.png[/img]

Every customer that leaves your store will go to a special machine where they can share their thoughts about their visit 💬. Was it good 👍, or did they leave angry 😡? Based on that feedback, Corporate will review your performance as the manager of SuperStore. If everything is in order, you can expect a promotion 📈. If not, punishment will be imminent ⚠️.

[b]Now we have a question for you - our community. What else should influence the mood of the customer? Share your ideas in the comments 💬, and we’ll see if we can implement them. Become a part of creating this title! 🌟
[/b]

notes.title: It’s all connected
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/37b4cb7b786d48fc01fd4860697b679b09f13b4a.png[/img]
There is nothing more common in the land of Ameryka than opportunities. You, as a barn finder, made your wealth by turning someone else's trash into gold and treasure. You dived through trash cans, old barns, old movie studios or even a moon base (spoilers) and flipped whatever you found there into hard earned cash. But what if you want to look for opportunities outside the life of a pawnshop owner?  There are many opportunities to do so, and we are working and them as we speak. And in each of them you will be able to see traces of our previous work. And as in title - it’s all connected 🙂

Let me show you some of the examples:

In Farm Simulator you will have the opportunity to make contracts with various client bases. From time to time some well known character will order a stock of what would seem like a base for a moonshine. Who is this handsome man? I think you know 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/cf9e563c5810dc24121fea6e882ce39be14f2cad.png[/img]

Not mentioning the branding of the anti weed specific. We know for sure - it should work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/773015c61711a4295c4644c55f273ef9c9439691.jpg[/img]

And when you run off the farm supplies, where will you get the best delivery? No other place than a Superstore! Call them and make an order delivered straight to your mailbox! (Contractors are still work in progress, so don’t mind the rest of them).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/a569f0a95deec46fcec478572c01661e146a0646.png[/img]

But that also works the other way around! When you want the most fresh and perfect vegetables and farm products, you can always order them from William’s Farm and they will be delivered to your store with a proper logo on it. Isn’t that cool?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856923/d1bed02f1042c0c096c87aad70566af870e21d3d.png[/img]

And will Uncle Billy and the gang visit Superstore? Who knows? They have to buy toilet paper somewhere 🙂

If you want to see what other opportunities and cross references you can find in our games don't hesitate to add Farm Simulator and Superstore to your wishlist to be in the loop!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2334600/Farm_Simulator/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2466000/Superstore_Simulator/

And if you haven't check the Barn Finders yet you can buy a base game with a 45 % discount, so don’t hesitate to jump into the Land of Ameryka - opportunities await!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/991170/Barn_Finders/
